item.title: Universal Music Posts Mixed Q4 2025 Financials Amid Streaming Slowdown, Says It’s Shelved U.S. Listing Despite Pershing Push
item.description: Universal Music Group (UMG) has posted modest Q4 2025 revenue growth due largely to a continued paid-streaming slowdown.
